# Paths TruffleHog does not scan.
#
# Scope: test fixtures, and this file. A negative test for a credential-handling path has to contain
# something that looks like a credential, and the case under test is that the code refuses it. Those
# literals are unverifiable by construction, and they are the only findings this exists to silence.
#
# This file excludes itself so that documenting that rule here cannot itself become a finding — which
# is how the first version of this file failed its own scan.
#
# Production code is deliberately NOT excluded, and neither are the integration and end-to-end
# suites, which carry real secrets through environment files and workflow variables. A scanner that
# skipped those would be silent exactly where a leak would matter.
#
# One pattern per line, as a regular expression matched against the path.
^\.github/trufflehog-exclude-paths\.txt$
__tests__/
\.test\.[cm]?tsx?$
\.spec\.[cm]?tsx?$
